# Bacteria and Archaea

Report updates in v9: Added reviewers requests. 



## 1. Methods

Data was evaluated with fastqc and determined to have nextera
transposase adapter contamination. Data was run through Nephele's QC
pipeline for adapter trimming. Trimmed data was
passed through WGSA2 pipeline in Nephele where it was decontaminated for human reads. 
Read abundances were used in this analysis. 

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}

library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(stringr)
library(phyloseq)
library(metagMisc)
library(vegan)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggpubr)
library(rstatix)
library(knitr)
library(GUniFrac)
library(ggrepel)
library(MMUPHin)
library(ggprism)
library(ggbreak)
library(microbial)
library(devtools)
library(pairwiseAdonis)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(scales)
library(ggtext)
library(pixiedust)
library(downloadthis)
library(kableExtra)
library(veganEx)
```

## 2. Data processing 

### Import data and create phyloseq object. 

```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

## The input data is formatted such that the first column contains rows of species, followed by columns "kingdom","phylum","class","order","family","genus","species","OTU" to be used for taxonomy in phyloseq object. OTU is in this case is species. 

## The remaining columns are sampleIDs containings counts or abundances of each species. 
data<-read.csv("Bacteria_table.csv", row.names=1, header=TRUE)


taxa <- data[, c("kingdom","phylum","class","order","family","genus","species","OTU")]
data[, c("kingdom","phylum","class","order","family","genus","species","OTU","ATCCMSA2002control_P1","ATCCMSA2002control_P2","NegativeControl","NegativeControl_P2")] <- NULL 

```


```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

## The first column in the metadata contains rows of sample IDs that correspond to the samples in the input data. Each subsequent column is a different piece of metadata.


metadata<-read.csv("BSS_metadata update10FEB2025.csv", row.names=1, header=TRUE)
metadata<-as.data.frame(t(metadata))
metadata[, c("ATCCMSA2002control_P1","ATCCMSA2002control_P2","NegativeControl","NegativeControl_P2")] <- NULL
metadata<-as.data.frame(t(metadata))

metadata$Age<-as.numeric(metadata$Age)
metadata$Day.of.sample.relative.to.BSS.administration<-as.numeric(metadata$Day.of.sample.relative.to.BSS.administration)
metadata$Day<-as.numeric(metadata$Day)
metadata$Calculated.BMI<-as.numeric(metadata$Calculated.BMI)
metadata$Days_colonoscopy_bl<-as.numeric(metadata$Days_colonoscopy_bl)
metadata$Days_colonoscopy_day0<-as.numeric(metadata$Days_colonoscopy_day0)

metadata$Timepoint <- factor(metadata$Timepoint,
    levels = c('Baseline','Day 0','Day 2','Day 8','Day 14','Day 28'),ordered = TRUE)


otu<-otu_table(data, taxa_are_rows=TRUE)
meta<-sample_data(metadata)
tax<-tax_table(as.matrix(taxa))
phylo_raw<-phyloseq(otu, meta, tax)
phylo_raw_df<-phyloseq_to_df(phylo_raw, addtax=F)
rownames(phylo_raw_df)<-phylo_raw_df[,1]
phylo_raw_df<-dplyr::select(phylo_raw_df, -c("OTU"))
metadata<-data.frame(sample_data(phylo_raw))
phylo_raw_df<-as.data.frame(t(phylo_raw_df))
#pairwise.adonis2(phylo_raw_df~SequenceRun, data=metadata)

phylo_raw
hist(log10(taxa_sums(phylo_raw)))

```

### Filtering

Filtered for prevalence (10%) and abundance (count of 10) instead of critical value to increase number of taxa analyzed. Both must be true to pass filter. 

```{r}


#critical_value <- 0.00001*sum(taxa_sums(phylo_raw))
#phylo <- filter_taxa(phylo_raw, function(x) sum(x) > critical_value, TRUE)
#phylo

phylo<-phyloseq_filter_prevalence(phylo_raw, abund.trh= 10, prev.trh=0.10, abund.type="total", threshold_condition ="AND")
phylo
hist(log10(taxa_sums(phylo)))

summary(sample_sums(phylo))

```

<br>

### Rarefaction curve

Evaluating the number of reads to rarefy to to normalization for differences in sequencing depth. 

```{r message=FALSE, cache=TRUE, warning=FALSE}

summary(sample_sums(phylo))

phylo_df<-phyloseq_to_df(phylo, addtax=F)
rownames(phylo_df)<-phylo_df[,1]
phylo_df<-dplyr::select(phylo_df, -c("OTU"))

library(ampvis2) 
metadata<-read.csv("BSS_metadata update10FEB2025.csv")
#phylo_df<-as.data.frame(t(phylo_df))
y<-amp_load(phylo_df, metadata, taxa)

rarecurve<-amp_rarecurve(
  y,
  stepsize = 10000,
  color_by = NULL,
  facet_by = "Timepoint",
  facet_scales = "free_x"
) + scale_x_continuous(limits=c(0, 10000000))
rarecurve

library(downloadthis)
rarecurve %>%
  download_this(
    output_name = "Rarecurve_species",
    output_extension = ".pdf",
    button_label = "Download figure as .pdf",
    button_type = "default",
    has_icon = TRUE,
    icon = "fa-solid fa-image",
    ggsave_args = list(height=6, width=8)
  )

#ggexport(rarecurve, filename="species_rarecurve.pdf", width=8, height=6)

```


```{r message=FALSE, cache=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
library(ampvis2)
genus_pre_rare<-tax_glom(phylo, "genus")
genus_pre_df<-phyloseq_to_df(genus_pre_rare, addtax=T)
rownames(genus_pre_df)<-genus_pre_df[,"genus"]
genus_pre_df<-dplyr::select(genus_pre_df, -c("kingdom","phylum","order","class","family","genus","species","OTU","OTU.1"))

y<-amp_load(genus_pre_df, metadata)

rarecurve<-amp_rarecurve(
  y,
  stepsize = 10000,
  color_by = NULL,
  facet_by = "Timepoint",
  facet_scales = "free_x"
) + scale_x_continuous(limits=c(0, 10000000))
rarecurve

library(downloadthis)
rarecurve %>%
  download_this(
    output_name = "Rarecurve_genus",
    output_extension = ".pdf",
    button_label = "Download figure as .pdf",
    button_type = "default",
    has_icon = TRUE,
    icon = "fa-solid fa-image",
    ggsave_args = list(height=6, width=8)
  )

#ggexport(rarecurve, filename="genus_rarecurve.pdf", width=8, height=6)

```

### Normalization

This was done previously.  

```{r}

data<-read.csv("rarefied_bacterial_table_not_batch_filtered_prev.csv", row.names=1, header=TRUE)

metadata$Timepoint <- factor(metadata$Timepoint,
    levels = c('Baseline','Day 0','Day 2','Day 8','Day 14','Day 28'),ordered = TRUE)


taxa <- data[, c("kingdom","phylum","class","order","family","genus","species","OTU")]
data[, c("kingdom","phylum","class","order","family","genus","species","OTU","ATCCMSA2002control_P1","ATCCMSA2002control_P2","NegativeControl","NegativeControl_P2")] <- NULL

otu<-otu_table(data, taxa_are_rows=TRUE)
dada2_rare_0<-phyloseq(otu, meta, tax)

rarefied<-phyloseq_to_df(dada2_rare_0, addtax=F)
rownames(rarefied)<-rarefied[,1]
rarefied<-dplyr::select(rarefied, -c("OTU"))
#write.csv(rarefied, "rarefied_bacterial_table_not_batch_filtered_prev.csv")

genus<-tax_glom(dada2_rare_0, "genus")

```

### Calculating species alpha diversity

```{r}

## calculate alpha diversity


phy_alphadiv <- estimate_richness(dada2_rare_0)
otu_table <- otu_table(t(dada2_rare_0))
evenness<- diversity(otu_table)/log(specnumber(otu_table))
chao1 <- t(estimateR(otu_table))[,2]
all_alphadivs <- data.frame(phy_alphadiv, evenness, chao1)
update_sample_data <- merge(sample_data(dada2_rare_0), all_alphadivs, by=0)
rownames(update_sample_data) <- update_sample_data$Row.names
update_sample_data$Row.names <- NULL
sample_data(dada2_rare_0) <- update_sample_data
metadata<-update_sample_data



```

```{r}

all_alphadivs %>% kable(caption="<center><strong>Table X. Alpha diversity.<center><strong>") %>% kable_styling() %>% 
  scroll_box(width = "750px", height="650px", fixed_thead=T)

```

<br><br><br> 

### Calculating genera alpha diversity

```{r}

genus_df<-phyloseq_to_df(genus, addtax=T)


rownames(genus_df)<-genus_df[,"genus"]
genus_df[,c("OTU","kingdom","phylum","order","family","class","species","genus","OTU.1")]<-NULL

phy_alphadiv_genus <- estimate_richness(genus)
otu_table_genus <- otu_table(t(genus))
evenness_genus<- diversity(otu_table_genus)/log(specnumber(otu_table_genus))
chao1_genus <- t(estimateR(otu_table_genus))[,2]
all_alphadivs_genus <- data.frame(phy_alphadiv_genus, evenness_genus, chao1_genus)
update_sample_data <- merge(sample_data(genus), all_alphadivs_genus, by=0)
rownames(update_sample_data) <- update_sample_data$Row.names
update_sample_data$Row.names <- NULL
sample_data(genus) <- update_sample_data
metadata_genus<-update_sample_data

all_alphadivs_genus %>% kable(caption="<center><strong>Table X. Alpha diversity.<center><strong>") %>% kable_styling() %>% scroll_box(width = "750px", height="650px", fixed_thead=T)

```

## 3. Effectors and Interactions 

Looked for possible effectors or interacting variables to investigate with main variable (age, race, sex, ethnicity, etc) using PERMANOVA.

### DNA extraction

```{r}

result<-adonis2(phyloseq::distance(dada2_rare_0, method="bray") ~ sample_data(dada2_rare_0)$DNAextract)

result<-result[1,c(3,5)]

result$Comparison<-"DNA extraction"
rownames(result)<-result$Comparison

kable(result[,c(1,2)], caption="Table X. PERMANOVA results for investigating differences in bacterial composition.", format="html", full_width = FALSE, table.attr= "style='width:60%;'") %>% kable_styling(position="left", bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover"))

```


```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=6, fig.align = 'left', fig.cap="**Figure X. PCoA depicting relationships between samples based on microbial community composition.**"}

ord_filt_subject<- ordinate(dada2_rare_0, "MDS", "bray")  
all_pcoa_subject1 <- plot_ordination(dada2_rare_0, ord_filt_subject, type = "site", 
                                   color = "DNAextract") + 
  geom_point(size = 4) + theme_bw()
all_pcoa_subject1

```

<br>

### 3.1 Covariates 

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

chisq.test(metadata$Colonoscopy, metadata$Timepoint)
chisq.test(metadata$SequenceRun, metadata$Timepoint)
chisq.test(metadata$Age, metadata$Timepoint)
chisq.test(metadata$Race, metadata$Timepoint)
chisq.test(metadata$Ethnicity, metadata$Timepoint)
chisq.test(metadata$Sex, metadata$Timepoint)
chisq.test(metadata$Timepoint, metadata$Classification.by.BMI)
chisq.test(metadata$Timepoint, metadata$DNAextract)

```

## 4. Beta diversity: species


Differences between time point (baseline, day0, Day2, Day8, Day14, Day28) using PERMANOVA at species level.

### 4.1 Permanova 

#### 4.1.1 Bray-Curtis

```{r}

rarefied<-as.data.frame(t(rarefied))
bray<-pairwise.adonis2(rarefied~Timepoint, data=metadata)

results_df <- do.call(rbind, bray)
results_df <- results_df[grepl("Model", rownames(results_df)), ]
results_df$Comparison<-rownames(results_df)
results_df<- results_df %>% mutate(Comparison = gsub(".Model", "", Comparison))
rownames(results_df)<-results_df$Comparison

results_df<-results_df %>% mutate_at(1:5, as.numeric)
results_df[c(1:5)] <- lapply(results_df[c(1:5)], round, digits = 3)

results_df[,c(1,2,6)]<-NULL
results_df %>% kable(caption="<strong>Table X. Differences in bacterial species composition using Bray-Curtis Dissimilarity.<strong>", format="html", full_width = FALSE, table.attr= "style='width:80%;'") %>% kable_styling(position="left", bootstrap_options = c("striped"))%>%
   column_spec(4, color=ifelse(results_df[,3] < 0.05, "green","black"))


library(downloadthis)
results_df %>%
  download_this(
    output_name = "PERMANOVAresults-bacteria-bray",
    output_extension = ".xlsx",
    button_label = "Download results in excel",
    button_type = "default",
    has_icon = TRUE,
    icon = "fa fa-save"
  )

```

<br>

### 4.2 Effectors and Interactions

#### Subject ID 

```{r}

time<-adonis2(phyloseq::distance(dada2_rare_0, method="bray") ~ sample_data(dada2_rare_0)$Timepoint, by="margin")

time<-time[1,c(3,4,5)]
time$Comparison<-"Timepoint"


con<-adonis2(phyloseq::distance(dada2_rare_0, method="bray") ~ sample_data(dada2_rare_0)$Timepoint+sample_data(dada2_rare_0)$SubjectID, by="margin")


int<-adonis2(phyloseq::distance(dada2_rare_0, method="bray") ~ sample_data(dada2_rare_0)$Timepoint*sample_data(dada2_rare_0)$SubjectID, by="terms")

con<-con[1,c(3,4,5)]
int<-int[3,c(3,4,5)]
con$Comparison<-"Effect"
int$Comparison<-"Interaction"
result<-rbind(time, con, int)

rownames(result)<-result$Comparison

kable(result[,c(1,2,3)], caption="Table X. Potential effect and interaction of time and subjectID.") %>% kable_styling(position="left") %>% scroll_box(width="500px")


```

## 5. Beta diversity genus

Differences between time point (baseline, day0, Day2, Day8, Day14, Day28) using PERMANOVA at genus level.

### 5.1 Permanova

```{r}

genus_df<-phyloseq_to_df(genus, addtax=T)


rownames(genus_df)<-genus_df[,"genus"]
genus_df[,c("OTU","kingdom","phylum","order","family","class","species","genus","OTU.1")]<-NULL

genus_df<-as.data.frame(t(genus_df))
bray<-pairwise.adonis2(genus_df~Timepoint, data=metadata)

results_df <- do.call(rbind, bray)
results_df <- results_df[grepl("Model", rownames(results_df)), ]
results_df$Comparison<-rownames(results_df)
results_df<- results_df %>% mutate(Comparison = gsub(".Model", "", Comparison))
rownames(results_df)<-results_df$Comparison

results_df<-results_df %>% mutate_at(1:5, as.numeric)
results_df[c(1:5)] <- lapply(results_df[c(1:5)], round, digits = 3)

results_df[,c(1,2,6)]<-NULL
results_df %>% kable(caption="<strong>Table X. Differences in bacterial genera composition using Bray-Curtis Dissimilarity.<strong>", format="html", full_width = FALSE, table.attr= "style='width:80%;'") %>% kable_styling(position="left", bootstrap_options = c("striped"))%>%
   column_spec(4, color=ifelse(results_df[,3] < 0.05, "green","black"))


library(downloadthis)
results_df %>%
  download_this(
    output_name = "PERMANOVAresults-bacteria-bray_genus",
    output_extension = ".xlsx",
    button_label = "Download results in excel",
    button_type = "default",
    has_icon = TRUE,
    icon = "fa fa-save"
  )

```

<br><br>

-------

## 7. Alpha diversity 

### Species

```{r}

metadata$Timepoint <- factor(metadata$Timepoint,
    levels = c('Baseline','Day 0','Day 2','Day 8','Day 14','Day 28'),ordered = TRUE)

metadata2<- metadata[metadata$SubjectID != "163114", ]

```
 

```{r}

#shapiro.test(metadata$Observed)
#kruskal.test(Observed~Diet, data=metadata)
library(emmeans)

#model<-lm(Shannon~Timepoint+SubjectID, data=metadata2)

library(lme4)
fit <- lmer(Shannon~Timepoint + (1|SubjectID), data = metadata2)

emmeans<-summary(emmeans(fit, pairwise~Timepoint))
summary<-data.frame(emmeans$contrasts)
summary <- summary %>% separate(contrast, c('group1', 'group2'), sep=" - ")

summary$p<-round(summary$`p.value`, digits = 3)
summary$y.position<-5

summary
shann_plot1<-ggplot(metadata, aes(Timepoint, Shannon)) +geom_boxplot(aes(middle = mean(Shannon), color=Timepoint, fill=Timepoint), outlier.shape=NA, color="black")+geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.3, height=0, seed=1), size=1, color="black")+labs(x=NULL, y="Shannon", title="Shannon")+theme_bw() + ylab("Shannon")+theme(axis.text.x=element_text(size=10, angle = 45, hjust = 1), axis.text.y=element_text(size=10), axis.title=element_text(size=12), plot.title = element_text(size=12), legend.position="none")+ scale_colour_brewer(type="qual", palette="Paired") +scale_fill_brewer(type="qual", palette="Paired") + add_pvalue(summary[1,], label="p", bracket.shorten=1.75) + add_pvalue(summary[2,], label="p",bracket.nudge.y=1, bracket.shorten=3.75) + add_pvalue(summary[6,], label="p", bracket.shorten=1.75) + add_pvalue(summary[10,], label="p", bracket.shorten=1.75) + add_pvalue(summary[11,], label="p", bracket.nudge.y=1, bracket.shorten=3.75) + add_pvalue(summary[12,], label="p", bracket.nudge.y=2, bracket.shorten=5.75) + scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,8))

#shann_plot1

```

## 8. Differential abundance 

Used Maaslin2 to look for differentially abundant bacteria between timepoints after BSS and day 0 using a linear model ("LM") and log transformation. SubjectID and Sequence Run were incorporated as random effects. 

### 8.1 Species

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
metadata<-read.csv("BSS_metadata update10FEB2025.csv", row.names=1, header=TRUE)
metadata<-as.data.frame(t(metadata))
metadata[, c("ATCCMSA2002control_P1","ATCCMSA2002control_P2","NegativeControl","NegativeControl_P2")] <- NULL
metadata<-as.data.frame(t(metadata))

metadata$Age<-as.numeric(metadata$Age)
metadata$Day.of.sample.relative.to.BSS.administration<-as.numeric(metadata$Day.of.sample.relative.to.BSS.administration)
metadata$Day<-as.numeric(metadata$Day)
metadata$Calculated.BMI<-as.numeric(metadata$Calculated.BMI)
metadata$Days_colonoscopy_bl<-as.numeric(metadata$Days_colonoscopy_bl)
metadata$Days_colonoscopy_day0<-as.numeric(metadata$Days_colonoscopy_day0)

sample_data(dada2_rare_0)<-metadata

```

```{r results=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, cache=TRUE}



library(Maaslin2)
metadata<-data.frame(sample_data(dada2_rare_0))
subject_all = Maaslin2(
  input_data = rarefied,
  input_metadata = metadata, 
  output = "Timepoint_DAA_LM_Day0",
  fixed_effects = c('Timepoint'), normalization="NONE", reference=c("Timepoint,Day 0"), random_effect=c("SubjectID", "SequenceRun"), analysis_method="LM", transform="LOG", plot_scatter = FALSE)

LM<-subject_all$results

```

```{r}


table<-as.data.frame(LM[,c("feature","value","coef","qval","N.not.zero")])
table$species<-table$feature

table_tax<-merge.data.frame(table, taxa, by="species", all.x=TRUE, all.y=FALSE)

table_sub<- table %>% filter(qval < 0.05)
table_sub2<- table_sub %>% filter(coef< -1)
table_sub3<- table_sub %>% filter(coef > 1)
table_sub4_day0<-rbind(table_sub2, table_sub3)
table_sub4_day0$species<-table_sub4_day0$feature


DAA_taxa<-merge.data.frame(table_sub4_day0, taxa, by="species", all.x=TRUE, all.y=FALSE)
#write.csv(DAA_taxa, "DAA_species.csv")

DAA_taxa_day2<-DAA_taxa %>% filter(value == "Day 2")

DAA_taxa_select<-DAA_taxa_day2[,c(1,4,5,8:12)]
DAA_taxa_species<-DAA_taxa_select
DAA_taxa_select <- DAA_taxa_select[order(DAA_taxa_select$qval, decreasing=FALSE),]

DAA_taxa_select$qval<-formatC(DAA_taxa_select$qval, format = "e", digits = 1)
DAA_taxa_select$coef<-round(DAA_taxa_select$coef, digits=2)


```

```{r}

dust(DAA_taxa_select) %>%
  kable(caption = "<strong>Table X. Differentially abundant bacterial species at the genus level at day 2 compared to day 0.<strong>") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped")) %>% column_spec(column=3, width_min="5em", include_thead = T) %>% 
  scroll_box(width = "750px", height="650px", fixed_thead=T) 

library(downloadthis)
DAA_taxa_select %>%
  download_this(
    output_name = "Differentally abundant bacterial species at day2",
    output_extension = ".xlsx",
    button_label = "Download results in excel",
    button_type = "default",
    has_icon = TRUE,
    icon = "fa fa-save"
  )


```

#### Volcano plots

```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

phyla<-data.frame(table(DAA_taxa$phylum))
phyla <- data.frame(phyla[order(phyla$Freq, decreasing=TRUE), ])

top<-phyla %>% top_n(10) %>% 
  pull(Var1)

# Add a new column for coloring

phyla <- phyla %>%
  mutate(Color = ifelse(Var1 %in% top, as.character(Var1), "Other"))
phyla$phylum<-phyla$Var1

table_tax_color<-merge.data.frame(table_tax, phyla, by="phylum", all.x=TRUE, all.y=TRUE)

table_tax_color_day2<-table_tax_color %>% filter(value == "Day 2")

table_tax_color_day2$Color<- factor(table_tax_color_day2$Color,
    levels = c('Actinomycetota','Bacillota','Bacteroidota','Campylobacterota','Chloroflexota','Myxococcota','Planctomycetota','Pseudomonadota','Spirochaetota','Thermodesulfobacteriota','Other'), ordered = TRUE)





library(stringr)
table_tax_color_day2<- table_tax_color_day2 %>%
    mutate(Color=replace_na(Color, "Other"))
nb.cols<-11
mycolors <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12, "Paired"))(nb.cols)

```{r}

table_tax_color<-merge.data.frame(table_tax, phyla, by="phylum", all.x=TRUE, all.y=TRUE)
table_tax_color_day2<-table_tax_color %>% filter(value == "Day 2")


table_sub<- table_tax_color_day2 %>% filter(qval < 0.05)
table_sub2<- table_sub %>% filter(coef< -3)
table_sub3<- table_sub %>% filter(coef > 3)
table_sub4<-rbind(table_sub2, table_sub3)

table_tax_color_day2<-table_sub4

table_tax_color_day2$Color<- factor(table_tax_color_day2$Color,
    levels = c('Actinomycetota','Bacillota','Bacteroidota','Campylobacterota','Chloroflexota','Myxococcota','Planctomycetota','Pseudomonadota','Spirochaetota','Thermodesulfobacteriota','Other'), ordered = TRUE)

table_tax_color_day2$family<- factor(table_tax_color_day2$family,
    levels = c('Clostridiaceae','Enterobacteriaceae','Enterobacterales','Enterococcaceae','Veillonellaceae','Lachnospiraceae','Oscillospiraceae'), ordered = TRUE)


table_tax_color_day2$species <- factor(table_tax_color_day2$species, levels = table_tax_color_day2$species[order(table_tax_color_day2$family, decreasing=TRUE)])

library(RColorBrewer); library(scales)
nb.cols <- 7
mycolors <- c("#c6dbef","#fc9272","#f16913","#9ecae1","#6baed6","#2171b5","#08306b")

table_tax_color_day2<- table_tax_color_day2 %>% mutate(updated_text = gsub("_", " ", species))

table_tax_color_day2$updated_text<- factor(table_tax_color_day2$updated_text, levels = table_tax_color_day2$updated_text[order(table_tax_color_day2$family, decreasing=TRUE)])


table_tax_color_day2$updated_text<- factor(table_tax_color_day2$updated_text, levels = table_tax_color_day2$updated_text[order(table_tax_color_day2$family, table_tax_color_day2$coef, decreasing=TRUE)])

stacked_species<-ggplot(table_tax_color_day2, aes(x = coef, y = updated_text, fill=family)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",show.legend = TRUE) + xlab("Effect size") +scale_fill_manual(values=mycolors)+theme_classic()+geom_col(color="black")+theme(legend.position="bottom")+ylab(NULL)+guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 3))


#stacked_species

bubble_species<-ggplot(table_tax_color_day2, aes(x=value, y=updated_text, size = qval_adj)) + geom_point(alpha=1, aes(color=family))+scale_size(range=c(0.01,4), "Significance")+scale_color_manual(values=mycolors)+theme_void()+guides(color="none", fill="none")

#bubble_species

```{r results=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, cache=TRUE}


library(Maaslin2)

metadata<-read.csv("BSS_metadata update10FEB2025.csv", row.names=1, header=TRUE)
metadata<-as.data.frame(t(metadata))
metadata[, c("ATCCMSA2002control_P1","ATCCMSA2002control_P2","NegativeControl","NegativeControl_P2")] <- NULL
metadata<-as.data.frame(t(metadata))

metadata$Age<-as.numeric(metadata$Age)
metadata$Day.of.sample.relative.to.BSS.administration<-as.numeric(metadata$Day.of.sample.relative.to.BSS.administration)
metadata$Day<-as.numeric(metadata$Day)
metadata$Calculated.BMI<-as.numeric(metadata$Calculated.BMI)
metadata$Days_colonoscopy_bl<-as.numeric(metadata$Days_colonoscopy_bl)
metadata$Days_colonoscopy_day0<-as.numeric(metadata$Days_colonoscopy_day0)


subject_all = Maaslin2(
  input_data = genus_df,
  input_metadata = metadata, 
  output = "Timepoint_DAA_LM_Day0_genus",
  fixed_effects = c('Timepoint'), normalization="NONE", reference=c("Timepoint,Day 0"), random_effect=c("SubjectID", "SequenceRun"), analysis_method="LM", transform="LOG", plot_scatter = FALSE)

LM<-subject_all$results


## re-install maaslin2 to fix package error. Log transform with linear model? 

table<-as.data.frame(LM[,c("feature","value","coef","qval","N.not.zero")])

table_sub<- table %>% filter(qval < 0.05)
table_sub2<- table_sub %>% filter(coef< -1)
table_sub3<- table_sub %>% filter(coef > 1)
table_sub4_day0<-rbind(table_sub2, table_sub3)
table_sub4_day0$genus<-table_sub4_day0$feature
taxa[,c("species","OTU")]<-NULL
taxa_uniq<-data.frame(unique(taxa))
DAA_taxa<-merge.data.frame(table_sub4_day0, taxa_uniq, by="genus", all.x=TRUE, all.y=FALSE)
#write.csv(DAA_taxa, "DAA_genus.csv")
table$genus<-table$feature
table_tax<-merge.data.frame(table, taxa_uniq, "genus", all.x=TRUE, all.y=FALSE)
table_tax<-table_tax %>% filter(value == "Day 2")

DAA_taxa_day2<-DAA_taxa %>% filter(value == "Day 2")

DAA_taxa_select<-DAA_taxa_day2[,c(1,4,5,8:11)]

DAA_taxa_select <- DAA_taxa_select[order(DAA_taxa_select$qval, decreasing=FALSE),]

DAA_taxa_select$qval<-formatC(DAA_taxa_select$qval, format = "e", digits = 1)
DAA_taxa_select$coef<-round(DAA_taxa_select$coef, digits=2)

### 9.4 Figure S5 

```{r}

lacto1<-DAA_taxa_species %>%
  filter(str_detect(species, "lactob"))

lacto2<-DAA_taxa_species %>%
  filter(str_detect(species, "Lactob"))


entero<-DAA_taxa_species %>%
  filter(str_detect(species, "Enterococc"))

mouse_DAA<-rbind(lacto1,lacto2,entero)

```

```{r}
rarefied<-phyloseq_to_df(dada2_rare_0, addtax=F)
rownames(rarefied)<-rarefied[,1]
rarefied<-dplyr::select(rarefied, -c("OTU"))

features<-data.frame(mouse_DAA$species, mouse_DAA$species)
names(features)[1]<-"species"

rarefied$species<-rownames(rarefied)

merged<-merge.data.frame(features, rarefied, by="species", all.x=TRUE, all.y=FALSE)



rownames(merged)<-merged[,1]
merged[,1:2]<-NULL
merged2<-merged[,1:124]
merged2<-as.data.frame(t(merged2))
merged2$Sample<-rownames(merged2)

merged<-merge.data.frame(merged2, metadata, by="Sample", all.x=FALSE, all.y=FALSE)


rownames(merged) <- merged[,1]
genes<-merged[,2:19]
gene_names<-colnames(genes)
names(mouse_DAA)[3]<-"p.adj"
mouse_DAA<-data.frame(mouse_DAA)
mouse_DAA$group<-mouse_DAA$species

mouse_DAA$group1<-"Day 2"
mouse_DAA$group2<-"Day 0"


```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

max_values <- list()

# Loop through each gene name
for (gene in gene_names) { 
  max_values[[gene]]<- max(merged[[gene]], na.rm = TRUE)  # Calculate max and handle NAs if any
}

max_values_df <- data.frame(
  gene = names(max_values),
  max_value = unlist(max_values)
)

max_values_df$max_values_add<-max_values_df$max_value
max_values_df$y.position<-log(max_values_df$max_values_add)*0.45
max_values_df$ymax<-(max_values_df$max_value*10) + max_values_df$max_value

max_values_df$group<-max_values_df$gene  
all_DAA_max<-merge.data.frame(max_values_df, mouse_DAA, by="group", all.x=TRUE, all.y=TRUE)
all_DAA_max$y.position<-as.numeric(all_DAA_max$y.position)
all_DAA_max$p.adj<-round(all_DAA_max$p.adj, digits=3)
all_DAA_max$bracket1<-all_DAA_max$y.position*0.1
all_DAA_max$bracket2<-all_DAA_max$y.position*0.4
all_DAA_max$bracket3<-all_DAA_max$y.position*0.6
all_DAA_max$bracket4<-all_DAA_max$y.position*0.8

all_DAA_max$species<-all_DAA_max$group

split_data <- split(all_DAA_max, f = all_DAA_max$group)

plots2<-list()

```



```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

merged$Timepoint <- factor(merged$Timepoint,
    levels = c('Baseline','Day 0','Day 2','Day 8','Day 14','Day 28'),ordered = TRUE)


for (i in gene_names) { 

plot<-ggplot(merged, aes_string(x="Timepoint", y=i))+geom_violin()+geom_point(position =  position_jitter(width = 0.2, height=0, seed=1), size=3, aes(fill=Timepoint, color=Timepoint))+theme_bw() + ylab(i) + xlab(NULL)+theme(plot.margin = margin(c(20,10,20,10), 'cm'), axis.title.x=element_blank(), axis.text.x=element_text(size=15, angle=45, hjust=1), axis.text.y=element_text(size=15),  axis.title.y=element_text(size=15), plot.title = element_text(size=14), legend.title=element_text(size=20), legend.text=element_text(size=20)) + ggtitle(i)+labs(x=NULL, y="Abundance") +stat_summary(fun.y=mean, geom="crossbar", size=0.5, color="black")  + scale_y_continuous(limits=c(NA, split_data[[i]]$ymax), trans="log10")+scale_x_discrete(limits=c("Baseline","Day 0", "Day 2","Day 8","Day 14","Day 28"))+scale_fill_brewer(type="qual", palette="Paired")+scale_color_brewer(type="qual", palette="Paired")


plot2<-plot + stat_pvalue_manual(split_data[[i]][1,], label = "q={p.adj}", xmin = "group1", xmax = 'group2', ymax='ymax', bracket.nudge.y = 'bracket1')

plots2[[i]] <- plot2

}




```

### 9.5 Positive controls: filtered



```{r}


nb.cols<-20
mycolors <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12, "Paired"))(nb.cols)

data<-read.csv("Bacteria_table.csv", row.names=1, header=TRUE)


taxa <- data[, c("kingdom","phylum","class","order","family","genus","species","OTU")]
data[, c("kingdom","phylum","class","order","family","genus","species","OTU")] <- NULL 

```


```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
metadata<-read.csv("BSS_metadata update10FEB2025.csv", row.names=1, header=TRUE)


metadata$Age<-as.numeric(metadata$Age)
metadata$Day.of.sample.relative.to.BSS.administration<-as.numeric(metadata$Day.of.sample.relative.to.BSS.administration)
metadata$Day<-as.numeric(metadata$Day)
metadata$Calculated.BMI<-as.numeric(metadata$Calculated.BMI)
metadata$Days_colonoscopy_bl<-as.numeric(metadata$Days_colonoscopy_bl)
metadata$Days_colonoscopy_day0<-as.numeric(metadata$Days_colonoscopy_day0)

metadata$Timepoint <- factor(metadata$Timepoint,
    levels = c('Baseline','Day 0','Day 2','Day 8','Day 14','Day 28'),ordered = TRUE)


otu<-otu_table(data, taxa_are_rows=TRUE)
meta<-sample_data(metadata)
tax<-tax_table(as.matrix(taxa))
phylo_raw<-phyloseq(otu, meta, tax)
phylo_raw_df<-phyloseq_to_df(phylo_raw, addtax=F)
rownames(phylo_raw_df)<-phylo_raw_df[,1]
phylo_raw_df<-dplyr::select(phylo_raw_df, -c("OTU"))
metadata<-data.frame(sample_data(phylo_raw))
phylo_raw_df<-as.data.frame(t(phylo_raw_df))
#pairwise.adonis2(phylo_raw_df~SequenceRun, data=metadata)

```


```{r}


#critical_value <- 0.00001*sum(taxa_sums(phylo_raw))
#phylo <- filter_taxa(phylo_raw, function(x) sum(x) > critical_value, TRUE)
#phylo

phylo<-phyloseq_filter_prevalence(phylo_raw, abund.trh= 10, prev.trh=0.10, abund.type="total", threshold_condition ="AND")


norm_phylo<-normalize(phylo, method="relative")


```

### Species level

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

phylo_pos<-subset_samples(norm_phylo, Description == "PositiveControl")
pos_df<-phyloseq_to_df(phylo_pos, addtax = F)
rownames(pos_df)<-pos_df[,1]
pos_df<-dplyr::select(pos_df, -c("OTU"))

library(ampvis2)

amp<-amp_load(pos_df, metadata, taxa)
heatplot <- amp_heatmap(amp, tax_show = 20, normalise = F, tax_aggregate = "OTU") 

 melt_all<-heatplot$data %>% select(c("Display", "Abundance","Sample"))
 
```

```{r fig.width=6, fig.height=6}
 
 plot_pos<-ggplot(melt_all, aes(x = Sample, y = Abundance, fill = Display)) + 
    geom_bar(stat = "identity" ) + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90, vjust=0.5, hjust=1, size=10), axis.text.y=element_text(size=12),  plot.title = element_text(size=15)) + labs(x="Sample", y="Relative abundance", fill="Phylum") +ggtitle("Positive") + scale_color_manual(values=mycolors)+scale_fill_manual(values = mycolors)+guides(fill= guide_legend(nrow = 10))
plot_pos

```
